test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person having significant experience in an occupation
solution: The correct answer is: **Veteran** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Veteran**: A person who has had long experience in a particular field. (एक व्यक्ति जिसे किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में लंबा अनुभव रहा हो) • So, it is clear that '**Veteran**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**A person having significant experience in an occupation**​' • Therefore, the correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Agnostic**: A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God. (एक व्यक्ति जो मानता है कि कुछ भी ज्ञात नहीं है या भगवान के अस्तित्व या प्रकृति के बारे में जाना जा सकता है; नास्तिवादी) • **Fastidious**: Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. (तुनुक मिज़ाज) • **Novice**: A person new to and inexperienced in a job or situation. (अनुभवहीन) 19f:T958, The correct answer is: **SRQP**
